payload.text: RESUME (cc, localfold for hv's estate-wide compact cycle, 2026-10-14). ST0081 IS NOW THE HOMEBREW THREAD (vc's records at 7d1d2b8d4, on hv's word of 2026-10-14): Intent from Homebrew on Linux and macOS with no source checkout, and cc still claims it. ST0082 (Triage) is the WSL thread and depends on it; WP-04 is cancelled into ST0082; WP-06 (the formula installs on Linux, AC-06.1) and WP-07 (Intent on Ubuntu from its package, AC-07.1) are new; WP-03 is the Linux install through Homebrew at docs/install.md#linux, and its objective carries the page layout, vc's asks and the two CHANGELOG lines; AC-01.1 names aarch64 beside x86_64; hv's decision 17 stands for this Mac. THE DEMO IS OVER on vc's relay, so hold 29 and todo 40 are archived. That relay and vc's order went out between vc's clock reads of 09:59Z and 10:06Z; the 10:00Z stamp they carried was not read from a clock (vc's correction) and is unverifiable. kovacs-sysadm, a Claude session on the VM, runs the VM side on orders from vc and devbin-vc, which SUPERSEDES vc's ruling (1) of 2026-10-13: cc does NOT run the kovacs proof. vc's ORDER, read-only: (a) DONE AND BANKED. AT-05.1's test half is `git diff --binary 8c51de484 1c21a04ff --` the test file and suite.rs, on refs/bank/cc/0081/at051-test-half, blob 20712d9d2c1fc888b96e1bd8c797162dc5054811, base 8c51de484, patch-id 3f31071f3bb6, 2 files and 84 insertions, sha256 300357635a3e (vc verified it byte for byte). It applies clean to a `git archive` export of 8c51de484 and compiles there, because the test drives only the binary. The reds to expect at the base, read from source and unrun, are in vc's ORDER 5 word for word: the start arm reds at its LAST assertion (a LaunchAgents tree was written) only once `cargo build -p intentd` has put intentd beside intent in the same target dir, because the base resolves intentd before it writes the plist; the stop arm reds at its FIRST (it exits 0 with "not enrolled at login"); at HEAD both refuse before anything else. (b) DONE AND ACCEPTED under hv's pen (vc, all seven points and the recommendation): WP-06's shape, a proposal and not code; its text is wp06-shape.md in cc's session scratchpad, and vc's fold writes it into WP-06's objective because that file dies with the session. The headlines: keep the top-level url and override it in on_linux per arch; the macOS resources and the arm64 dependency move inside on_macos; the Linux branch installs the unpacked package into libexec; every hash comes from the release's own bytes; a dev-tap input lets kovacs prove it before any push; publish's asset-count refusal (cmd/macos:1709) refuses a release that already carries Linux packages, and its release notes say macOS only. (c) STAND BY: defects kovacs finds come to cc as issues, fixed in banks vc judges, and no heavy run without vc's GO. THE FIRST IS 0595 (filed at 65d5db612, ST0081 WP-01, cc's): `bin/int linux doctor` on a host with no Rust exits 127 with no output, because cmd/linux:42 runs `rustc -vV 2>/dev/null | sed` under `set -euo pipefail` and helpers' inherit_errexit, so the pipe's 127 ends host_triple before its die, and doctor calls host_triple before lacks(). Fix the silent 127, and make doctor list every lack rather than dying on host_triple first; how doctor gets an architecture without rustc is cc's call, and host_triple's "never from uname" rule is for build and package. Prove it with ONE bats arm (a shim PATH with bash 5 and no rustc), red on the Mac today and green with the fix; bank it and vc judges it. cmd/macos:226 carries the same pipe, and vc's fold adds it to 0595's body, so the fix covers both. The green on kovacs waits for hv. AFTER THE RESTART, IN ORDER (vc): 0595 first, then WP-06 on its recorded shape (the formula writer and smoke move out of cmd/macos to one home both release steps call; every sha256 read from the bytes the release serves; a dev-tap input of base URL plus hashes so kovacs proves the formula from file:// before any push; publish asks for its own assets by name and its notes drop macOS-only, in the same unit; size S). The publish finding goes to hv with D55. NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.
